data.content_ref: inline:The proposition in SRC_003—that experts detect 'gestalt' anomalies—contradicts the premise of SRC_001 that expert intuition is merely a high-variance process subject to cognitive biases. While SRC_001 views intuition as a liability to be filtered by a checklist, SRC_003 views it as a superior high-dimensional synthesis tool. This relation is refuted if it is proven that 'gestalt' anomalies can be perfectly decomposed into a linear checklist without loss of detection accuracy.
